text:
[LEXP.7.12.1] The only slot type that carries runtime type variation is
`Json` ([LEXP.7.12.5], [LADP.5.5.3]). When a leaf access on a `Json` path
evaluates in an arithmetic or comparison operator and the runtime leaf type
doesn't match the operator's expectation, the operation raises a **TypeError**.
Unless a deciding operand absorbs it ([LNUL.4.2]), the activation is abandoned
([IRET.9.6]) and the fault reaches the fault surfaces, a `TypeError` fault fact
among them ([LERR.9.1]). An absorbed TypeError reaches none ([LERR.1.4.11]).

**The operation does not evaluate to `false`, and nothing propagates.** A
wrong-typed leaf is data — expected in normal operation and attributable to a
node — which is why it is a `TypeError` and not an `EngineError`; the same
operation on a value that was schema-committed means the artefact lied
([IRET.9.6]).

Absence is a different question and is not this clause's: an unresolved path
reads as `null` and propagates under Kleene ([LNUL.8.4]).

idris.name: lexp_7_12_1__container_under_an_operator_traps
idris.note: An array or an object a path reads, in arithmetic with an Int on either side or ordered against one, is a trap and never a value, for every operator, object, array and Int -- the clause's TypeError, absorbed by a deciding operand as any trap is ([LNUL.4.2]). A scalar leaf of the wrong kind traps by the same arms (the String and Bool rows of `lnul_4_1__arith` and `lnul_4_1__cmp`) and is not restated; the fault surfaces of [LERR.9] are not modelled.

idris.name: lnul_8_4__read
idris.note: A leaf reads as a value of the kind it was written with -- an integer an Int, a float a Float, a string a String, a Bool a Bool -- and a container as a `Json` value, so the operator it meets judges the kind at run time.
